sources.title: Nintendo — Nintendo Switch 2 Tech Specs
quotes: Maximum of 3840x2160 (4K) resolution at 60 fps (TV mode)
Supports 120 fps when 1920x1080/2560x1440 resolutions are selected
2 USB Ports (USB 2.0 compatible) on the side

sources.title: Nintendo Support — Playing in TV Mode (Switch 2)
quotes: Do not use the Nintendo Switch AC adapter [ HAC-002(EUR)] when connecting a Nintendo Switch 2 console to a TV (this can charge the console, but there will be no video output to the TV).
A Nintendo Switch dock cannot be used because the Nintendo Switch 2 console cannot be plugged into it.
TV mode is power-intensive. Make sure to plug the AC adapter directly into an outlet without using a power strip.
If there is another device connected between the dock and the TV (such as an HDMI selector), disconnect it and connect the dock directly to the TV using the HDMI cable.

sources.title: Nintendo Support — How to Connect a Nintendo Switch 2 Console to a TV
quotes: A Nintendo Switch 2 AC Adapter (model no. NGN-01)
Important: The HDMI cable included with Nintendo Switch is not Ultra High Speed and cannot be used to play Nintendo Switch 2 in TV mode.
